_note: The trip ladder: how many trips a run needs before each feature switches on. Change a number here to move a milestone; add a new feature by giving it a line and reading prog.milestones.<name> in code. 'maps' (where given) lists the maps the feature is allowed on. 'portals.waves' is a list: each entry spawns 'count' side-road gates (on different edges) once the trips are reached and the stadium exists. To add two more at the next thousand, append {"afterTrips": 5000, "count": 2}.
